researchQuestion: Which calculations agree with an independent library under matched inputs, and how do geometry, temperature-factor clipping and inverter model choices change controlled annual energy and array ranking?
baseline: Preserve study01 and production model unchanged; input frozen-bundle from sheffield-2026-10-25-analysis

reference.solarPosition: spa_python how=numpy delta_t=67.0, geometric zenith/elevation for POA; actual UTC interval-midpoint timestamps
reference.irradiance: isotropic plus ground reflection; ASHRAE b=0.05 applied only to direct component; zero all components at geometric elevation<=0
reference.temperature: faiman u0=25 u1=6.84; same weather wind values as application

controlledConfiguration.reason: An explicitly diagnostic monofacial no-extra-loss copy isolates common front-side components. Original bifacial/lossy scenario is not relabelled or overwritten.

componentChecks: Original solar geometry vs SPA: signed elevation difference; circular azimuth difference. Report all hours, SPA elevation>5 degrees, and absolute SPA elevation<=5 degrees separately. Report mean absolute, root mean square and maximum differences, and fraction daylight elevation differences>0.5 degrees as investigation flag, not acceptance standard.
Matched application geometry: pvlib beam+ASHRAE, isotropic diffuse and ground reflection vs exported original front components; identical daylight gating. No validation of rear proxy.
Faiman with original effective irradiance and unadjusted wind: implementation parity only; no temperature field validation.

PVWatts DC with original effective irradiance and temperature vs application temperature-adjusted ideal DC, separating raw formula and application clipped temperature factor; count nonzero-irradiance cap-trigger hours.

controlledStages.definition: Native application, controlled monofacial no-extra-loss configuration
pvlib front/temperature/DC with application geometry; retain application temperature cap and ported application inverter. Integration parity; copied inverter policy is not independently validated.
Replace only geometric solar position with SPA; keep temperature cap and ported application inverter
SPA geometry, remove application temperature-factor clipping; keep ported application inverter
SPA geometry, standard linear DC, replace inverter with pvlib PVWatts at the same40kW AC cap

arrayGrid.interpretation: Same9options as study01 but controlled monofacial configurations; ranking agreement here does not validate original bifacial result

metrics: paired stage deltas kWh and percent
daylight geometry errors including near horizon
nonzero-output temperature clipping counts and DC energy effect
array winner/ranking comparison by historical year
policy: No calibration or tuning to reduce disagreement after viewing results. Record failures and investigate. These are implementation checks and model-choice sensitivity, not measured-plant accuracy or operational forecasting. No energy superiority/novelty assumed.
knownSharedAssumptions: Frozen ERA5 inputs and original adaptation are shared, not independently validated.
Generic Faiman coefficients use unadjusted10m wind rather than calibrated module-height wind.
Thermal calculations use post-IAM effective irradiance, shared with application; physical adequacy is not established.
Isotropic sky and generic ASHRAE coefficient remain shared modelling assumptions.
Protocol01 results were already inspected; this is a predeclared new retrospective diagnostic, not a fresh untouched holdout.
excluded: Site geometry, module or inverter calibration
App scientific corrections, UI changes or deployment
